details.description:
Cats love cleanliness and freshness just like you do, and that’s why Catsan litter is the choice for your cats. With Catsan Hygiene Plus you care for your cat’s natural needs and provide them with a litter box that’s always clean and hygienic. This cat litter offers extra mineral protection for long-lasting odour retention, making it hygienically clean. It absorbs before odour occurs giving cats a comfortable and safe space.
The natural lime and fine quartz sand in this cat litter tray give the quality granules their hygienically clean colour without any dangerous fibres or other incompatible substances. This non-clumping litter doesn’t stick to the fur as easily as clumping litter and is therefore not licked up during grooming which makes it the right cat litter suitable for all phases of life, including kittens. It contains a lot of air due to its porous structure and is, therefore, easier to carry.
Made with 100% natural ingredients, this cat litter box provides you and your furball a beautiful and comfortable feeling of being home. Catsan litter is a caring expert for demanding cat hygiene for more than 30 years. Usage: Fill the litter box at least 5 cm high with CATSAN Hygiene plus. Take out the solid waste daily and shake the litter box from time to time to keep the litter mixed up. Change the litter completely at regular intervals. If you have underfloor heating, please place an insulating material under the litter box. This will prevent odours that could be caused by heating the liquids bound in the granules.
Storage: Store in a dry place. Replace when it can no longer absorb urine

Catsan Natural Clumping Cat Litter is an exceptional choice for cat owners seeking an environmentally friendly and sustainable solution. Specially developed to meet your cat's natural needs, this litter is made from selected natural ingredients without any bleach or fragrance. The odour-binding litter and hygiene granules effectively soak up liquid, keeping the litter box noticeably clean and fresh. The litter forms strong clumps on contact with moisture, making it easy to scoop and maintain a clean environment. This feature also helps minimise odours and ensures quick cleanup. Catsan absorbs moisture quickly, controlling unpleasant smells and providing a fresh and clean atmosphere for both your cat and your home. With its hygienic, handy, and very economical properties, Catsan is the ideal choice for discerning cat owners looking to reduce their carbon footprint while ensuring the comfort and well-being of their feline companions.

Catsan sanitation sand for cats with odour control. Produced from natural sodium bentonites which are safe for your pets. It has the efficiency to control the odour. Ultra deodorising, ultra absorbency, ultra clumping.
